entries.name: Liberian Independence Day
entries.capsule: Liberia's 1847 independence, marked in Minnesota with a parade, ball, concerts, soccer and family gatherings each late July.
entries.dateRule: July 26 each year. Minnesota events cluster on the surrounding weekend, set by each organizer.

dates.source: Fixed date; CCX Media and Office Holidays state July 26

entries.whatItMarks: Liberia's declaration of independence on July 26, 1847. 2026 was the 179th anniversary.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: The community's largest public celebration, centered in Brooklyn Park and Brooklyn Center. Recent years include the We Are Liberian parade and Day in the Park (first held 2025), an OLM ball and youth music festival, a soccer match between teams styled after Liberia's rival clubs Mighty Barrolle and Invincible Eleven, concerts in Minneapolis, kickball and basketball tournaments, prayer services, and city and state proclamations (Brooklyn Park and the governor proclaimed Liberian Independence Week in 2019). People greet each other with 'My 26th is on you.' A 2026 match between Minnesota United and Liberia's national team was canceled when some players were denied visas.

entries.name: We Are Liberian Independence Day Parade & Day in the Park
entries.capsule: Free parade and festival with food, music, vendors and family activities for Liberian Independence Day in the northwest suburbs.
entries.dateRule: Held on July 26 in 2025 and 2026, as announced by We Are Liberian. Future dates announced each year.

dates.source: Sahan Journal listing of We Are Liberian event

entries.whatItMarks: Liberian independence, and in organizers' words a way to bridge the older and younger generations.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: First held July 26, 2025, from Shingle Creek Parkway to Centennial Park in Brooklyn Center with about 70 vendors, free with Eventbrite registration; thousands attended, some from as far as New York. In 2026 it moved to North Hennepin Community College in Brooklyn Park, parade at 11 a.m. and festival until 7 p.m. Co-founded by Marie Dweh.

entries.name: OLM Liberian Independence Twin Ball
entries.capsule: Formal evening ball hosted by the Organization of Liberians in Minnesota during Independence weekend.
entries.dateRule: Set each year by the Organization of Liberians in Minnesota, usually the Friday before or near July 26.
entries.whatItMarks: Liberian independence; a dress-up evening of music and networking.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: OLM held the 2026 ball at the Marriott Northwest in Brooklyn Park from 6 p.m. to 1 a.m.; OLM calls it Liberia's biggest Independence celebration. OLM also held a banquet dinner during Independence week in 2019.

minnesotaEvents.name: Independence Twin Ball
minnesotaEvents.place: Marriott Northwest, 7025 Northland Dr. N., Brooklyn Park

entries.name: Liberia Youth Music Festival and Independence Soccer Match
entries.capsule: Youth music, soccer and games for Independence weekend, including a mock match of Liberia's two famous rival clubs.
entries.dateRule: Set each year by OLM with the Liberian Sporting Association of Minnesota, on the Saturday of Independence weekend in 2026.
entries.whatItMarks: Liberian independence, through sport and youth culture.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: The Liberian Sporting Association of Minnesota has hosted Independence Day basketball, girls' kickball and boys' soccer since 2021, growing from about 1,000 to 3,000 attendees by its founder's account. In 2026 the match pitted teams in the colors of Mighty Barrolle and Invincible Eleven. OLM's page lists Northwoods Park Field, 9 a.m. to 8 p.m.; Sahan Journal listed Robbinsdale Armstrong High School at 5 p.m.

minnesotaEvents.name: OLM / LSA-MN soccer match
minnesotaEvents.place: Robbinsdale Armstrong High School (per Sahan Journal)

droppedSeedEntries.reason: The seed ties Watch Night to the 1862 Emancipation vigil, which is African American history. No opened source showed Liberian Minnesotans or their churches observing it under that meaning; New Year's Eve church services may occur but were not documented.
